measurement_environment: authorized Mac via production HTTP; no vendor credential used

cases.detail: Production 4H exactly matched a 09:30-anchored resample of production 5m history. Each source day had 78 5m rows. The corresponding 195M source split is 39/39. The March pair spans the US DST change.

Production 5m history returned 43 rows through a 13:00-stamped row on a 13:00 early close. The canonical actual-close filter admits 42 rows through 12:55. Production 4H included the 13:00 row, changing close and/or volume in all five cases. Canonical 195M source split is 39/3.

Sampled symbols without stored 5m history returned six 1h rows beginning at 10:00 ET and two derived 4H bars. Terminal falls back from missing 5m to provider-built 1h history, so exact 09:30-open whole-universe parity is not proven.

blocking_finding: Actual exchange close is not load-bearing in the Terminal stored-history session filter; whole-universe fallback also depends on provider-built 1h bars when 5m is absent.
